basic_profile.bio: New to the Reddit scene, I'm a 31-year-old from Plano, Texas, with a passion for Warhammer 40k models and black metal music. By day, I work as a software developer, and by night, I'm either painting miniatures or catching up on the latest metal releases. I’m still figuring out the nuances of Reddit, but I love connecting with others who share my hobbies. My weekends are often spent gaming or hunting for rare miniatures. I'm in a relationship and enjoy sharing my hobbies with my partner, who is surprisingly supportive of my growing collection.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in software development, which I studied at Texas A&M University. Over the years, I've self-taught many aspects of miniature painting and tabletop gaming through online tutorials and community forums. My love for black metal comes from a deep dive into music genres during college.
